description: Evaluator assertion thresholds and semantic-dimension thresholds (design-compiler machine / semantic evaluators and human-audit ledger). Void-ratio plausibility is NOT decided here: evaluators read the effective band of scene.composition.negativeSpaceRatio (CAS-VS, ADR-0001).

rules.title: Machine assertion focal-hierarchy (宾主揖让): focal offset, dominance separation, dominant-area range

payload.subject: EVAL_MACHINE_FOCAL_HIERARCHY
payload.rationale: 宾主关系可断言条件：焦点有明确位置 + 主辅面积有分离. A clear focal point = focal centre offset (0 = frame centre) below max_focal_center_offset. Legacy path: dominant-minus-secondary area above min_dominance_separation. Evidence path: dominant colour share strictly between min/max_dominant_area_ratio; secondary/accent areas are inferred only from at least min_luminance_peaks_for_tiers luminance peaks.

rules.title: Machine assertion qiyun-continuity (气韵连贯): motion continuity and optical-flow coherence

payload.subject: EVAL_MACHINE_QIYUN_CONTINUITY
payload.rationale: 气韵可断言条件：运动有连贯性且光流相干. PASS needs motion continuity above min_motion_continuity and optical-flow direction coherence above min_optical_flow_coherence; one of the two is INCONCLUSIVE; single-frame evidence is INCONCLUSIVE, never FAIL.

rules.title: Machine assertion spatial-depth-layers (层次与远近): measured depth layer count

payload.subject: EVAL_MACHINE_SPATIAL_DEPTH
payload.rationale: At least min_depth_layer_count measured depth layers is PASS, at least min_depth_layer_count_inconclusive is INCONCLUSIVE, fewer is FAIL; no depth buffer is INCONCLUSIVE (UNMEASURED is not FAIL). The DC code states no rationale beyond the thresholds.

rules.title: Machine assertion color-relationship (色彩关系): palette distinctness and contrast

payload.subject: EVAL_MACHINE_COLOR_RELATIONSHIP
payload.rationale: 色彩关系可断言条件：三色体系明确 + 对比度合理. PASS needs a distinct dominant / secondary / accent palette (require_distinct_palette) and a WCAG contrast ratio of at least min_contrast_ratio; one of the two is INCONCLUSIVE.

rules.title: Minimums declared by the former DC default evaluation profile that no evaluator applies

payload.subject: EVAL_MACHINE_DECLARED_MINIMA
payload.rationale: Declared by DC chinese-aesthetic/profiles/default.json (machine-assertion layer) but never read by any DC code path: the machine evaluator does not apply them and the semantic layer has its own decisions (EVAL_SEMANTIC_*). Kept so that no number of the deleted profile is lost; the compiler does not read them.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 宾主揖让: focal clarity and dominance separation evidence strength

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_BINZHU_YIRANG
payload.rationale: 证据支持度：焦点明确 + 主辅分离. Evidence strength = focal_clear_weight when the focal centre offset is below max_focal_center_offset, plus separation_clear_weight when dominance separation is above min_dominance_separation; >= pass_evidence_strength is PASS, >= inconclusive_evidence_strength INCONCLUSIVE, otherwise FAIL. Stricter than the machine focal assertion.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 计白当黑: void ratio inside the period band, continuous empty region

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_JIBAI_DANGHEI
payload.rationale: 留白非空，乃气之所在. The void ratio must lie inside the effective band of scene.composition.negativeSpaceRatio (ADR-0001: the evaluator carries no private ideal range) and the empty region must be continuous (continuity >= min_empty_region_continuity); both = PASS, one = INCONCLUSIVE, neither = FAIL.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 虚实相生: void presence, depth layers, atmospheric depth

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_XUSHI_XIANGSHENG
payload.rationale: 虚境与实景的互生. PASS needs a present void (void ratio above min_void_presence: a presence test, not a plausibility band, hence its own decision per ADR-0001), at least min_depth_layer_count depth layers and atmospheric depth >= min_atmospheric_depth; void or depth alone is INCONCLUSIVE.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 气韵连贯: motion, optical flow and luminance continuity evidence count

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_QIYUN_LIANGGUAN
payload.rationale: 气者，心之运；韵者，气之节. Counts how many of motion continuity (>= min_motion_continuity), optical-flow coherence (>= min_optical_flow_coherence) and luminance continuity (>= min_luminance_continuity) hold; pass_evidence_count or more is PASS, inconclusive_evidence_count or more INCONCLUSIVE. The motion thresholds are the machine assertion's decision.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 含蓄与留白: void presence, accent isolation, moderate contrast

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_HANXU_YULIUBAI
payload.rationale: 含蓄者，意不尽言；留白者，境不画满. PASS needs a present void (min_void_presence), accent isolation below max_accent_isolation (含蓄而不张扬) and a contrast ratio inside [min_contrast_ratio, max_contrast_ratio] (适度而不刺眼); void or accent isolation alone is INCONCLUSIVE.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 层次与远近: depth layers, layer separation, atmospheric depth

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_CENGCI_YUANJIN
payload.rationale: 远者淡，近者浓；高者虚，低者实. PASS needs at least min_depth_layer_count layers, layer separation >= min_layer_separation and atmospheric depth >= min_atmospheric_depth; layers or separation alone is INCONCLUSIVE.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 形神关系: focal clarity and material micro-detail

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_XINGSHEN_GUANXI
payload.rationale: 形者，物之态；神者，物之魂. PASS needs a clear focal point (the machine focal assertion's offset decision) and micro-detail distribution >= min_micro_detail_distribution; one of the two is INCONCLUSIVE.

rules.title: Semantic dimension 时间感/动势: motion, camera smoothness, optical flow

payload.subject: EVAL_SEMANTIC_SHIJIAN_DONGSHI
payload.rationale: 动势者，气之行；时间者，动之积. PASS needs motion continuity >= min_motion_continuity and (camera smoothness >= min_camera_motion_smoothness or optical-flow coherence >= min_optical_flow_coherence); motion or camera smoothness alone is INCONCLUSIVE. Looser than the machine qiyun assertion.

宋式美学理想参数: horizon position (share of the frame height) ideal range declared by the DC human-audit ledger. The ledger never consumed it (dead constant); registered so the quantity has a band. No TANG / MING range is documented.
